{{Top}}
'''Keen's Grotto''' was the location of a notorious catacomb complex on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. A team of four [[Spelunking/Legends|spelunkers]] became trapped there, necessitating rescue by a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] search and rescue squad, who deployed a [[GV/3-series guardian droid]] to save them. This incident became widely publicized, leading [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] to begin developing a modified version of the guardian droid with enhanced detection [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], [[emergency transponder]], [[Spotlight/Legends|spotlight]], and a packet of weather-proof [[Survival pack|survival gear]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote| In order to get through Keen's grotto, we had to lay on our stomachs and worm-crawl for what seemed like a football field... eventually the ceiling got so close to the floor that we had to take our helmets off and push them in front with our noses... eventually the ceiling got so close that we couldn't move forward unless we turned our heads sideways.|[[Daniel Wallace]]|<ref name="TF.N" />}}
Keen's Grotto is a real location in Indiana, where ''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]'' author [[Daniel Wallace]] once went spelunking with several college roommates, an experience he would later recall as being "unrelentingly miserable."<ref name="TF.N">{{JCFCite|url=posts/24370113|board=Literature|thread=New Essential Guide to Droids|user=[[Daniel Wallace|Dan Wallace]]|date=2006-07-13|time=8:20 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180409082832/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/new-essential-guide-to-droids.21671810/page-12}}</ref><ref name="Geekosity">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2007/06/forgotten-easter-eggs-im-not-huge-fan.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Forgotten Easter Eggs}}</ref>
